title: Monad Blitz @广州 (Guangzhou)
description: An in-person, one-day hackathon in Guangzhou on Saturday, November 21, 2026: a Monad 101 workshop in the morning, a build sprint from 12:00 to 18:30, then demos and voting. Open to Web2 developers with no onchain experience; teams of up to 3, registration subject to host approval.
reward: $1,500 in prizes: 1st $600, 2nd $500, 3rd $400, and a custom Monad mechanical keyboard for each of the top 3
ideas: A small prototype on Monad's parallel EVM
A first smart contract app built in one afternoon
setup: follow the Mojo event page after registering

rules: In person in Guangzhou on Saturday, November 21, 2026; the exact address is shown after registering. Agenda runs 09:00 to 21:00.
Registration is subject to host approval; organizers screen applications, so fill the application carefully.
Teams of at most 3 members, formed online beforehand or on site. Web2 developers without onchain experience are welcome.
Hacking runs 12:00 to 18:30; project submissions close at 18:30, then demos and voting.
After registering, follow mojo.devnads.com/events/18, where team sign-up, project submission and prize distribution are shown.
Prizes: 1st $600, 2nd $500, 3rd $400; the top 3 each get a custom Monad mechanical keyboard. Monad Foundation has final say on the rules.
